questDescription->A traditional cultural festival of [OAFaction_name] is coming soon. On this day in previous years, the court would distribute flower cakes to the local citizens to share the joy of the festival and enhance the festive atmosphere. However, this year's [OAFaction_name] encountered a challenge:
Due to the lack of manpower, the industrial department of the Golden Iris Palace in a certain area is currently facing a severe shortage of rat hands, to the point where they cannot even meet the demand for festive flower cakes. Therefore, the [OAFaction_leaderTitle] and [asker_nameFull] of the Golden Iris Orchid hope that you can assist the local court in fulfilling the festival's demand for flower cakes, which will significantly improve the local court's perception of you.

According to the judgment of the local coordination department, they probably still have a quantity gap of [requestedThingCount] and [requestedThing_label] (total value: [requestedThingMarketValue_money]). If we accept this request, [OAFaction_name] will provide the necessary raw materials for production and a flower cake processing machine, and a shuttle machine will arrive soon to collect the flower cakes.

If we complete this order, the willingness of [OAFaction_name] to provide assistance to us will increase. But if we fail to complete the order, [OAFaction_name] and the local citizens of Iris will be very disappointed with us.
Reasonfortask ->A series of construction projects are currently underway
Reasonfortask ->We are currently manufacturing a series of production equipment
Reasonfortask ->Selected personnel from the newly established settlement
Reasonfortask ->A large number of construction projects in the settlement have mobilized the vast majority of personnel
Reasonfortask ->Extreme snowstorms are causing urgent reinforcement of settlements
Reasonfortask ->A large number of personnel from the Ministry of Industry have been hospitalized due to food poisoning
Reasonfortask ->A large number of new employees are receiving training
